title: From Pythagorean Runs to Pell-Generated Cubic Runs
summary: A classical Pythagorean run is an identity in which a block of consecutive squares is equal to the immediately following block of consecutive squares. Boardman's construction gives such a run for every prescribed length. We consider a cubic analogue in which the second block is allowed to have common difference 2.
